tagline: Learn your language first, scroll later
brief: An app lock for Finnish learners: distracting apps stay locked each day until the study goal is met. It should feel disciplined but friendly, warm, and unmistakably Finnish.
criteria: Success: reads as both 'ä' and 'lock' at a glance, holds up at 16 px, works in one colour, stands apart from blue study apps.

concepts.name: Umlaut shackle
concepts.idea: The umlaut dots join into a shackle: ä becomes a lock.
rationale: One shape carries both meanings of the name: sana (word, the ä) and lukko (lock)
Coral shackle = the part that opens when today's goal is met
Cream and coral stand out on a home screen full of blue study apps

recommendation: Umlaut shackle in navy, coral and cream.
next_steps: Animate the shackle opening when the goal is met
